title: Улитка на тропинке

beats.action: Mia enters from right, notices snail near path edge.
beats.camera: wide vertical, camera gently lowers to child's eye level

beats.action: Mia stops, crouches and points without touching the snail.
beats.camera: slow push-in; gaze and finger target the snail

beats.action: Mia turns her head toward companion and says: Смотри, улитка!
Companion leans slightly, nods and smiles; snail slowly moves its tentacles.
beats.camera: short reaction shot, keep faces visible

beats.action: Mia looks back at snail and smiles; hold final composition.

safety_gates: Require approved references before locking character design.
